stable.notes: Control keeps the server switches you set by hand through Update Server: live Continue, the Codex queue, session hooks, the glasses question and approval switches, and the Messages trail. Pairs with server 6.52.0, where Codex threads show what Codex writes and the glasses can answer session questions and approvals (with glasses 6.9.512).

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
